title: KWF awards €2.7 million to three new childhood cancer research projects at Princess Máxima Center
description: The Dutch Cancer Society (KWF) awarded €2.7 million to fund three new research projects at the Princess Máxima Center, two of them Young Investigator Grants for early-career researchers, aimed at safer and more personalized treatments for children with cancer.

title: Amsterdam UMC onderzoekt gokschade met ZonMw-subsidie
description: Amsterdam UMC has received ZonMw funding for a five-year research programme on vulnerability to gambling harm, led by professor Ruth van Holst in collaboration with Radboud University, Maastricht University, University of Amsterdam and Erasmus University Rotterdam.

title: Open source-model geeft nieuw zicht op risicogedrag bij online gokken
description: University of Amsterdam researchers Reinout Wiers and Johan Bollen released a free, open-source AI model that estimates online casino players' risk of problem gambling, trained on two years of betting data from 13 Dutch operators.

title: ZonMw kent € 2,5 miljoen toe voor onderzoek naar gokschade
description: ZonMw awarded €2.5 million to a five-year research programme on prediction, prevention and early detection of gambling harm, led by Tranzo at Tilburg University.

title: UMC Utrecht krijgt 2,8 miljoen voor kankeronderzoek
description: UMC Utrecht has been awarded €2.8 million in funding for cancer research. The award was reported by healthcare outlet Zorgvisie/Skipr in mid-August 2026.

title: FAO, Wageningen Researchers Review Broad Range of AI Food Safety Applications
description: Researchers from the UN Food and Agriculture Organization and Wageningen published a review surveying the range of artificial intelligence applications being used across food safety. The review covers AI use cases relevant to food safety monitoring and assessment.

title: Leidse onderzoekers ontvangen miljoen voor onderzoek borstkankerbehandeling
description: Researchers in Leiden have been awarded a grant of around one million euros for research into the treatment of breast cancer tumours, according to local news outlet Sleutelstad. The report was published on 13 August 2026.

title: NWO head: research funders are grappling with big changes
description: Research Professional News reports on comments from the head of the Dutch Research Council (NWO) about the major changes research funding organisations are currently facing. The piece concerns national-level research funding policy rather than a single Dutch university.
